title: Add memory compaction policy
summary: Add an explicit memory compaction policy that can dry-run or apply bounded cleanup: delete expired working or episodic records, detach stale parent references, and mark old long-term records as stale context without deleting them.
expectedFailureModes: A compaction command deletes long-term memory that should only be marked stale.
Dry-run and apply compute different plans because parent references are evaluated after partial mutation.
A stale parent reference is left attached when the parent is deleted during the same compaction run.
A non-operator peer can compact memory owned by other peers.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant-memory compaction --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd memory_compaction --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant memory --locked
humanEscalation: Approval before automatic compaction schedules or destructive long-term memory deletion
nextAction: Integrated; next memory hardening slice should add automatic compaction scheduling policy only after operator approval and retention defaults are documented.
